note: All WIMAS groundwater irrigation points of diversion that reported use > 0 in 2021-2025 (no subsample). acres/af_yr = mean reported 2021-2025; crop = most frequent single crop reported 2021-2025, else CDL 250 m mode (2020-2024). sat_ft/decl/years from the state model at the point; null sat = outside the mapped aquifer. capped = 1 when y50 is at the 100-year cap (100 means 100 or more years).
